title: The Pot Place
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：element　|　正文 375 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 element 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Our teacher set the whole class the same task: find one thing in this town that is older than the town itself. Most of us chose the church. I chose the ① elements of a ruined kiln on the north hill — a floor of baked clay, a broken flue, and a heap of ash that had been rained on for a hundred and forty years. There is ② an element of luck in everything I have ever found, and that kiln was entirely luck: the clay, the element nobody notices until it is fired, was showing through the grass.

An archaeologist came in April. She knelt for an hour and said almost nothing, then asked what we knew about the ③ elements of a kiln: the chamber, the flue, the stoke hole, and the draught that makes fire behave. Fire, she said, is the oldest ④ element in every story human beings tell about themselves, and the most impatient one.

We made a list. Sand, lime, water, ash: each one ⑤ an element we could name, and none of them interesting until they were mixed. ⑥ The older elements of the village still called the place 'the pot place', and none of them could agree on the year. There were also elements of the town's own account — a tax roll, a letter, one line in a diary — and all three disagreed with each other.

In the summer the hill was opened to visitors and the ruin was left to the ⑦ elements, which is the polite way of saying that nobody protected it. Rain did in six weeks what a century had failed to finish. I had expected to mind. What I minded instead was how little the ⑧ elements of a place tell you, once the people who used them are gone.

I still go up there. ⑨ The elements of the trade, my teacher wrote in her report, are easily taught; the judgement is not — by which she meant that knowing what a flue is and knowing what it was for are different accomplishments. ⑩ Every element of that hillside is now on a card in a museum drawer. I have never been able to decide whether that is rescue or loss, and there remains an element of both.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 组成部分；要素
C. n. 自然力；风吹雨打（the elements）
D. n. 一点；某种成分（an element of）
E. n. 基础；基本原理；入门（the elements of）
F. 固定搭配：the elements of a trade 一门手艺的基础
G. n. （群体中的）分子；成员（常指某类人）

items.q: the elements of a ruined kiln
There is an element of luck
is the oldest element in every story
each one an element we could name
The older elements of the village

answers.why: 指窑炉遗存的“组成部分”：窑底、烟道、灰堆。
an element of luck 意为“一点运气”，指其中的运气成分。
the elements of a kiln 指窑炉的“基本构造、入门知识”，故后文逐一列举。
fire 被视为最古老的“元素”，与自然、化学元素同义。
沙、石灰、水、灰均为可名的“元素、物质成分”。
the older elements of the village 指村里年长的“那一批人、成员”。
be left to the elements 意为“任凭风吹雨打”，此处说无人加以保护。
指一个地方的“构成因素”，说人去之后这些成分说明不了什么。
the elements of a trade 意为“一门手艺的基础”，与 judgement 相对。
指山坡上的每一个“组成部分”，如今都进了博物馆的卡片抽屉。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我选择了北山上一座废窑的组成部分。（elements）
我找到的每样东西里都有点运气成分。（an element of）
她问我们对窑炉的基本构造知道些什么。（the elements of）
火是人类讲述的每一个故事中最古老的元素。（element）
那个夏天，废墟被任凭风吹雨打。（be left to the elements）
一门手艺的基础容易教，判断力不容易。（the elements of a trade）
answers: I chose the elements of a ruined kiln on the north hill.
There is an element of luck in everything I have found.
She asked what we knew about the elements of a kiln.
Fire is the oldest element in every story human beings tell about themselves.
That summer the ruin was left to the elements.
The elements of a trade are easily taught; the judgement is not.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 element 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: I chose the elements of a ruined kiln on the north hill: a floor of baked clay, a broken flue, and a heap of ash.
There is an element of luck in everything I have ever found, and that kiln was entirely luck.

Fire, she said, is the oldest element in every story human beings tell about themselves.
